Stony steps in “D”

Sorry, Gian Marco - that’s not correct. “Stony Steps” is actually the 2nd tune in the set of 3 reels. They got the order of tunes wrong on the sleeve notes. Molloy plays it in D - (albeit on an Eb flute).

I just heard this one on the Réalta album, noticed that it was the Stoney Steps - a tune which name I recognize, and somehow associate with Matt Molloy but still haven’t learned properly (or at all). Yet it sounds annoyingly familiar, and I don’t even have one single recording of the 31 (!) mentioned (OK, there is a tape of the black album somewhere, but it still sunds more familiar that it should, compared the low number of times I’ve listened to the tape).

Where have I heard it? Somewhere else?
